subtitle: Cross-reference for 26/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, the SIX national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent, Datafolha BR-00304/2026, Palver BR-09587/2026, PoderData/Aya BR-01739/2026, Alfa Inteligência/TMC BR-02512/2026, Real Time Big Data BR-04202/2026 and Futura/100% Cidades BR-05268/2026, the Datafolha state breakdowns of 25/Sep and the press flow of 25 and 26/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 42.50% (USD 12.33M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 1.00pp raw and 0.84pp normalized, reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he gives up 0.90pp, to 24.45% (USD 0.99M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, still the most recent, measure him from 43% at Palver, tied, to 38.4% at Futura, 2 points behind, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in one of the six.
fortes: At Datafolha on 24/Sep, the pollster with the highest reliability in the table, he leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 40% to 36% and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 47% to 45%, and it is the only one of the six national polls of that day that puts him ahead head to head.

Measuring each house against its own previous wave, he gained ground in three of the six: Datafolha, where the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) gap widened from 3 to 4 points, Palver, where he went from 1 point behind to a tie, and PoderData, where the lead widened from 1 to 2 points.

🔒 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures how locked in the choice is ten days before the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): 80% of the electorate say they are completely decided, and among his voters the figure is 87%, the highest on either side.

In the Datafolha state breakdown released on 25/Sep he leads in Pernambuco by 60% to 24% and is numerically ahead in Minas Gerais, by 39% to 37%, in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).
fracos: Gives up 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 42.50%, and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro reopens from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since 21/Sep.
In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he gives up 0.90pp raw and 0.68pp normalized, to 24.45%, with the sum of that pair going from 99.85 to 98.95.
In the series recorded since 14 April his price sits 25.00pp from the top, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 8.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

🔴 He loses ground in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, always against the previous wave of the same pollster: at Real Time his lead fell from 8 to 4 points, at Futura he went from 0.6 point ahead to 2 points behind, and at Alfa, Exame reports a fall from 14 to 7 points in the pollster's own series.

⚖️ In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing he loses in four of the six houses, and at Futura the deficit of 5.7 points, 43.7% against 49.4%, falls OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin of that poll.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he trails in São Paulo, by 38% to 33%, in Rio de Janeiro, by 44% to 38%, and in the Federal District, by 41% to 34% (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).
candidates.analise: Lula gave up 1.00pp in the winner contract, to 42.50% (USD 12.33M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, and 0.84pp normalized, because the pair sum fell from 99.05 to 98.65. With that the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro reopens from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since 21/Sep. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he gives up 0.90pp raw and 0.68pp normalized, to 24.45%. 🗳️ There was no new national poll on 25 and 26/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep still disagree about him: in the first round they run from 7 points ahead at Alfa/TMC to 2 points behind at Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads only at Datafolha, by 47% to 45%. In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he leads in Pernambuco, is in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in Minas Gerais and trails in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District. 📰 On the night of 25/Sep the government published the provisional measure that bans bets (O Globo and Estadão), and on 26/Sep it extended for 30 days the diesel subsidy of R$ 2.12 per litre (G1, CartaCapital and Poder360). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 56.15% (USD 11.91M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 0.60pp raw and 0.84pp normalized, reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he stays at 74.50% (USD 1.16M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, the most recent, measure him from 40.4% at Futura, where he leads, to 33% at Alfa/TMC, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six.
fortes: Rises 0.60pp in the winner contract, to 56.15%, and the gap over Lula reopens from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since 21/Sep.
His price is 5.55pp from the top of the series, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.

⭐ He leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent: 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, 48% to 45% at Palver, 46% to 45% at PoderData and 45% to 44% at Real Time, with a 43% tie at Alfa.

📌 The Futura advantage, of 5.7 points, is the only one of the six that falls OUTSIDE the margin of the poll itself, and the house describes it as a statistical advantage. It is not the first time in this base: of the 34 [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin and 8 of them favoured him.
In the Datafolha state breakdown released on 25/Sep he leads in São Paulo, by 38% to 33%, in Rio de Janeiro, by 44% to 38%, and in the Federal District, by 41% to 34% (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo).

🗳️ On 25/Sep Justice André Mendonça ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital).
fracos: He leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in only one of the six national polls of 24/Sep, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and trails in the other five, with the widest distance at Alfa/TMC, 33% against 40%.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he trails in Pernambuco, by 60% to 24%, and is numerically behind in Minas Gerais, by 39% to 37%, in a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico).

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

On the same day he asked the Supreme Court, in André Mendonça chambers, to investigate the relationship between Lula and Vorcaro, and Folha de S.Paulo records that the request comes from someone who is under investigation in the Dark Horse case.
🗣️ On 25/Sep Estadão reports that he said he tried to speak with Daniel Vorcaro in the four days before the banker's arrest to discuss the film Dark Horse.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro rose 0.60pp in the winner contract, to 56.15% (USD 11.91M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, and 0.84pp normalized. With that the gap over Lula reopens from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since 21/Sep, and his price is 5.55pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place contract he stays at 74.50% raw, up 0.68pp normalized because Lula's price in that pair fell. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep, still the most recent, he leads the first round in one, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six, and in the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he leads in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District. 🗳️ On 25/Sep Justice André Mendonça ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract (USD 5.02M cumulative volume) and 41.35% (USD 0.28M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, up 0.30pp raw and 0.06pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
fortes: Rises 0.30pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 41.35%, and the distance to Renan Santos narrows from 4.45pp to 4.15pp.

🔑 PoderData tests him in a pairing that contradicts the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) order: he beats Lula by 45% to 42%, the same score as the house wave of 17/Sep, and loses to Flávio Bolsonaro by 39% to 41%.
He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, with 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 7% in São Paulo, ahead of the other third way names in that state (G1).
📰 On 25/Sep, in Recife, he defended raising taxes on betting sites and said he backs neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro in a possible [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), as G1 reports.
fracos: Normalized by the sum of the third place book, which went from 102.25 to 102.85, his rise is only 0.06pp.
He gives way at Datafolha, from 6% to 5%, and at PoderData, from 8% to 6%, always against the previous wave of the same house.
At Futura he lost third place to Ronaldo Caiado: he fell from 6.5% to 5.6% while the other rose from 4.5% to 5.7%.
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
At Palver, which is the source of the polling side of the divergence chart in this round, he has only 2%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 0.30pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 41.35% (USD 0.28M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, and 0.06pp normalized, because the sum of the whole book went from 102.25 to 102.85. The distance to Renan Santos narrows from 4.45pp to 4.15pp raw, in the series of confirmed readings 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp, 4.45pp and 4.15pp. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time, and PoderData has him beating Lula in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 45% to 42%. In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 7% in São Paulo. 📰 On 25/Sep, in Recife, he said he backs neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro in an eventual second round, as G1 reports.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.45% (USD 14.48M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, down 0.25pp, and 45.50% (USD 0.41M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, unchanged raw and down 0.26pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2.4% at Futura to 8% at Palver.
fortes: Still leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, with 45.50%, 4.15pp ahead of Augusto Cury.
🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the LARGEST cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.48M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's.

🔑 And in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place book too: USD 1.37M, above the USD 1.16M of Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which is the one paying 74.50% there. Volume does not follow price in either book.
📰 According to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called him a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.
He is the most voted of the third way at Palver, with 8%, and second at Real Time, with 6%.
fracos: ⚖️ The lead in the third place book narrows from 4.45pp to 4.15pp, and normalized by the book sum, which went from 102.25 to 102.85, he gives up 0.26pp.
In the winner book his contract gives up 0.25pp, to 0.45%, below every point recorded in the series up to 25/Sep, the lowest of which was 0.60% on 24/Sep.
🔴 He falls from 11% to 8% at Palver against the house wave of 21/Sep, the largest fall of any name in that poll.

⚠️ The six national polls of the SAME day measure him at 8% at Palver, 6% at Real Time, 3% at Datafolha and at PoderData and 2.4% at Futura: the highest reading is more than three times the lowest, and because the six came out on the same day that distance cannot be put down to the calendar.
In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings he is the most distant opponent from Lula: 34% to 44% at Palver and 37% to 43% at Alfa.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 4% in São Paulo and 3% in Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District (G1).
candidates.analise: Renan Santos stayed at 45.50% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book (USD 0.41M cumulative volume), unchanged raw in the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, and gives up 0.26pp normalized, because the sum of the whole book went from 102.25 to 102.85. The lead over Augusto Cury narrows from 4.45pp to 4.15pp. In the winner book he gives up 0.25pp, to 0.45%, below every point recorded in the series up to 25/Sep, the lowest of which was 0.60% on 24/Sep. 🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 14.48M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's, and the same happens in the second place book, USD 1.37M against USD 1.16M for Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which pays 74.50% there. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 8% at Palver to 2.4% at Futura, and since all six came out on the same day that distance cannot be attributed to the calendar. 📰 According to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called him a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT, at the floor of the book, with USD 7.55M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and none of the six national polls of 24/Sep tests him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he stays at 1%, and in the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep he has 4% in Minas Gerais.

cruzamento: The day moved the two instruments in different ways. 💹 In the winner contract, the reading confirmed on 26/Sep, 12:00 BRT has Flávio Bolsonaro at 56.15%, up 0.60pp, and Lula at 42.50%, down 1.00pp, against the reading confirmed on 25/Sep at 17:08 BRT, and the gap over Lula reopens from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since 21/Sep. Normalized by the pair sum, which fell from 99.05 to 98.65, the move is 0.84pp for each side. 🔀 In the neighbouring books, in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second place book Lula gives up 0.90pp, to 24.45%, with Flávio Bolsonaro unchanged at 74.50%, and in the third place book Augusto Cury rises 0.30pp, to 41.35%, with Renan Santos unchanged at 45.50%, so the distance between the two narrows from 4.45pp to 4.15pp. 🏛️ The biggest move of the day was outside the presidential book: in the contract on the party with the most seats in the Senate, the Partido Liberal rises 3.50pp, to 92.50%, in a book of USD 0.31M. 🗳️ No new national poll came out on 25 and 26/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep are still the most recent, without agreeing on who leads either round. What came out were state breakdowns, and in Datafolha of 25/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro leads in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and the Federal District, Lula in Pernambuco, and Minas Gerais has a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). 📰 In the news, the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the Master case proceedings by 9-0 and shelved by 5-4 the request to investigate his conduct, the Supreme Court convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro 7-3 for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral, and the government published the provisional measure that bans bets and extended the diesel subsidy. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to polls or to acts: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.
